Lets{{sic}} see how you fair{{sic}} against my legion of pawns!|audio = FailedGatewayWave1-2-3.ogg|[[Titus (Narrator)|Titus]] on Wave 1 (Formerly, [[Failed Gateway]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Pawn''' was the second enemy to appear in [[Failed Gateway]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had fairly average health and speed, occasionally appearing with the [[Bloated]] and [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attributes. ==Appearance== The '''Pawn''' was a wooden construct with a brown body. It had dark brown short parts that were also torn, alongside two bandoliers on its torso. It wore multiple pieces of brown and grey armor, which consisted of shoulder-pads, elbow-pads and knee-pads, all with spikes. It also had a metal head piece with wires and a lens on its head. ==Strategy== *'''Pawns''' are weak enemies that can be dealt with by a majority of early game towers, such as the [[Crook Boss]], [[Golden Soldier]] and [[Brawler]]. **As they spawn in groups, towers that can damage multiple enemies at once are effective against them. *In Hard mode, some '''Pawns''' will spawn with the [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attribute. **Towers with a fast firerate like the [[Minigunner]] can be used to deal with this. **Units' collision damage is a great way to deal with [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] '''Pawns'''. Similarly, the [[Trapper]]'s traps will deal heavy damage to them. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.2.0GenericThumbnail8.png|'''Pawn''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} The Hexscape Trailer (HALLOWEEN) - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Pawn''' on a promotional video. }} ==Update History== *'''23 October 2024''' - [[v1.37.0]] **'''Pawn''' added. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Pawn''' removed. {{FailedGateway|Start|N/A|[[Quick Pawn]] & Pawn|Wave 1|[[Brain Bound]]|Wave 2}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
